policies.title: Approval policies
policies.description: Rules decide who must sign off on a new subscription. The first active policy (top of the list) that matches a request wins.
policies.empty: No policies yet — every request is approved automatically.
policies.emptyHint: Create a policy to start routing requests to approvers.
policies.deleteDescription: Existing requests keep their history. New requests will fall through to the next matching policy.

form.name: Policy name
form.appliesToAllHelp: Catch-all. Put it last so more specific policies match first.
form.thresholdHelp: Requests are normalised to a monthly amount and converted into this currency before comparing. Leave empty to ignore cost.
form.categoriesHelp: Only requests in these categories match. Combine with a threshold to narrow further.
form.reminderHelp: Days an approver can sit on a request before a reminder. Empty uses the organisation default ({default} days).
form.escalationHelp: Days idle before administrators are pulled in. Empty uses the organisation default ({default} days).
form.stepsHelp: Approvers decide in order. Use Manager → Role: Finance for the classic two-step chain.

approverTypeHelp.MANAGER: Falls back to the team approver, then administrators, when no manager is set.
approverTypeHelp.TEAM_APPROVER: Set per team under Organisation → Teams. Falls back to the manager, then administrators.
approverTypeHelp.ROLE: Everyone with the role is notified; the first decision wins.

teamApprover.title: Default approvers
teamApprover.description: The person who signs off requests from each team when a policy uses “Team default approver” or as the fallback for missing managers.
teamApprover.empty: No teams yet. Create teams first, then assign approvers here.
